status: Implemented; build, default and Worker validation passed
change: Mode caches the serialized size of its actual retained entries. New keys add one entry extent; duplicate updates adjust only the serialized count width. Initial restored contents are measured once. Per-update temporary entry records and the mode measurement generator are removed, along with the now-unused generic removal method.

cases: Exact full-checkpoint size and one-byte-short rejection at counts 9,10,99,100,1000 with escaped Unicode keys
Existing mixed-key Unicode and restored mode serialized-limit parity
Existing bounded retained growth and duplicate-storage tests

remaining: Mode key formatting still occurs before Map lookup; its scratch is admitted, but avoiding formatting may need a broader key representation contract.
Native numeric count formatting and runtime bookkeeping are not total-heap accounting.
Aggregate checkpoint request comparisons are now admitted (linked evidence); expression/evaluator allocation remains open.
No measured latency improvement is claimed from this structural change alone.
